name: pc-benchmark
description:
Offline Retrieval Benchmark
	

This benchmark evaluates offline (local database) retrieval performance for CVPR/NIPS/ICLR 2020–2024.
It is designed to mirror the local search behavior used by agent.py, but runs without network access.

	
		
		Files
	


benchmarks/offline_queries.jsonl: Query set (JSONL).
benchmarks/run_offline_benchmark.py: Benchmark runner.
